8.5.12 Ramp routines
In case of a change of the input value, the ramp output value follows the input value
with a specified limited slope.
Mfl_ParamRamp_Type and Mfl_StateRamp_Type are the data types for storing ramp
parameters. Usage of Switch-Routine and Jump-Routine is optional based on the func-
tionality requirement. Usage of Switch-Routine, Jump-Routine, Calc-Routine and Out-
Method have the following precondition concerning the sequence of the calls.
• Mfl_RampCalcSwitch
• Mfl_RampCalcJump
• Mfl_RampCalc
• Mfl_RampOut_f32
